masters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a NEW 4-column by 4-row sprite atlas of 16 human hero avatars for the Aventura Lectora e-ink game. Input1 is the EXACT hero style and identity reference; input2 shows eight monster designs to inspire eight genuinely new outfits. Preserve the reference male and female faces: big simple black oval eyes, tiny smiling mouth, round large head, male short tousled dark hair, female shoulder-length wavy dark hair, mitten hands, chunky boots, about 2.8-head-tall chibi proportions. Flat white/light gray/dark gray with thick black outer contours, clean simple shapes, NO color, NO gradients. All are HUMAN heroes wearing costumes, never animal people or transformed monsters. EACH row contains two different outfits; columns1-2 are male/female of the first outfit, columns3-4 male/female of the second. Exact arrangement: row1 mushroom boar outfit (mushroom-cap hood open to human face, small tusk shoulder plates, spore tunic) then thorn stag outfit (antler circlet, thorn-embroidered mantle, leaf-edged belt). Row2 leaf lynx outfit (pointed-ear fabric hood, layered leaf cape, paw-shaped cuffs) then acorn badger outfit (striped hood, acorn shoulder armor and sturdy short coat). Row3 bramble bear outfit (rounded-ear hood, broad thorn shoulder armor and bramble cloak) then oak beetle outfit (stag-beetle horn helmet open to face, wing-case shoulder plates, segmented breastplate). Row4 moss turtle outfit (moss-trim cap, turtle-shell back cape and shell chest piece) then vine griffin outfit (feathered crest circlet, vine-edged feather mantle, wing-shaped shoulder plates). Male and female of each outfit share the SAME costume motifs and equal coverage/armor, only hairstyle and natural fit differ; NO sexualization. Standing relaxed front view, full body, hands down, no weapons, no pets, no backgrounds, no floating props. Exactly16 separate sprites, generous transparent gutters and safety margin INSIDE every equal cell; no cropping of hats, capes, boots or antlers. TRUE transparent alpha background. No text, borders, labels or grid lines. Match the supplied hero silhouette and line weight very closely; these must look like native additions to the existing wardrobe, yet each design must be newly drawn, not copies of reference costumes.
